latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release with new free AI model management for OpenClaw via OpenRouter:

- Introduces the FreeRide skill to automate selection, ranking, and fallback setup of free AI models.
- Adds CLI tool (`freeride`) and optional watcher utility for auto-rotation on rate limits.
- Updates OpenClaw configuration with optimal free model and dynamic fallback chain—preserves user’s other settings.
- Provides detailed usage instructions, troubleshooting steps, and command reference.
- Removes legacy molt.py script; all functionality migrated to new components.
